test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**wrap up**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes the atmosphere in the market as the news of the Emergency starts to disseminate and businesses begin closing.
 
• The appropriate phrasal verb should indicate an action that means to close or finish.
 
• "**Wrap up**" fits well as it denotes finishing or closing operations, aligning with the context of shops preparing to close.
 
• Other options ("**open up**", "**pop up**", "**chicken out**") do not fit
